card_title: Artist Notes: Purifying Charcoal Bar Soap
summary: Draw out the urban grit. A cold-processed, highly porous charcoal bar that magnetically binds to bodily toxins and environmental pollutants.
description: Intense dermal purification. This dense, black bar soap utilizes activated carbon to deeply cleanse the pores, while a base of saponified olive and coconut oils ensures the skin barrier remains unstripped.
technical_overview: Offered at $14.0 for 150g, this KoColor SOAP is expertly formulated with Saponified Oils, Activated Charcoal, and Shea Butter. It delivers a high-fidelity Carbon Black color profile (`#1A1A1A`) and leverages high-porosity toxin absorption.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Lather between hands and apply to wet skin. Rinse thoroughly.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Highly effective as a targeted treatment for body acne; leave lather on affected areas for 2 minutes before rinsing.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Activated charcoal features millions of micro-pores, vastly increasing its surface area to trap hydrophobic toxins.
